timeInvoiceDesc: Select completed, billable hours from your team's accessible client projects.
legacyInvoices: This client has invoices from the previous time-billing workflow. Those invoices have no linked time records. Review them before selecting hours to avoid billing past work again.
noHours: No unbilled, completed billable hours in this period.
firstEntries: Showing the first 500 entries. Narrow the dates or invoice these entries first.
fallbackDesc: Only used for entries without a recorded rate.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Retry with this selection to recover the invoice safely.
creationError: Could not confirm creation. Retry to check this same invoice.
trackedDesc: Hours and rates recorded when this invoice was created.
noTracked: This invoice has no linked time records.
deleteInvoice: Are you sure you want to delete this invoice?
currencySelectionRequired: Configure the currency in each project’s profitability settings before invoicing. Select time from one currency only.

financialSettings.title: Organization currency
financialSettings.description: Default currency for new business records, independent of language. Flowlio subscriptions keep the plan currency.
financialSettings.confirm: I understand that this applies to new records. Existing amounts retain their recorded currency; no currency conversion is performed.
financialSettings.saveError: Unable to save. Refresh the settings and try again.
financialSettings.reportCurrency: Report currency: {{currency}}. Entries in other or unknown currencies excluded: {{count}}. No conversion applied.
financialSettings.precision: Billing currently supports currencies with two decimal places. Historical records without a currency require review before billing.
financialSettings.reviewDescription: Select only records whose existing amounts you have verified. Up to 50 records of each type are shown; confirm at most 50 at a time. This does not convert money or change the organization default.
financialSettings.reviewConfirm: I verified that the selected amounts ({{count}} records) are already in {{currency}}. No currency conversion will be performed.
financialSettings.reviewError: Unable to confirm. A record may have changed, already have a currency, or conflict with linked financial records. Refresh and review again.
financialSettings.reviewConflictChanged: This record has changed or already has a currency. Refresh the list and review it again.
financialSettings.reviewConflictLinkedChanged: The linked revenue has changed. Refresh the list and review it again.
financialSettings.reviewConflictConfirmation: Review the linked revenue and check the additional confirmation before continuing.
financialSettings.reviewConflictCurrency: Linked records already use {{currencies}}. Select their original currency only if the existing amounts are actually in that currency; otherwise, review the source record.
financialSettings.reviewForbidden: Only the organization owner can confirm historical currencies.
financialSettings.reviewInvalid: The selection is incomplete or invalid. Refresh the list and select the records again.
financialSettings.reviewRequestError: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh the records before trying again.
financialSettings.reviewBlocked: Linked records use {{currencies}} and cannot be changed here. Review the source record or select the original currency of these amounts.
financialSettings.reviewLinkedHint: Linked revenue is currently recorded in {{currency}}. Additional review is required.
financialSettings.reviewLinkedDescription: Older invoices may have generated revenue in a default currency. Verify the original records before correcting it. This changes only the recorded currency, without converting amounts or creating a new charge.
financialSettings.reviewLinkedConfirm: I verified that the original invoice and linked revenue amounts are in {{currency}} and authorize correcting the recorded currency for the listed revenue entries.
financialSettings.reviewBatchUnchanged: No records in this batch were changed. Review the indicated record or deselect it to continue with the others.
financialSettings.noUnresolved: No records with missing currencies in this batch.
